pli-tv-kd3:1.1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-kd3:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ vassāvāso apaññatto hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:1.1.3: te 'dha bhikkhū hemantam pi gimham pi vassam pi cārikaṃ caranti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.2: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā hemantam pi gimham pi vassam pi cārikaṃ carissanti haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā bahū khuddake pāṇe saṃghātaṃ āpādentā.
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.3: ime hi nāma aññatitthiyā durakkhātadhammā vassāvāsaṃ alliyissanti saṃkāpayissanti,
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.4: ime hi nāma sakuntakā rukkhaggesu kulāvakāni karitvā vassāvāsaṃ alliyissanti saṃkāpayissanti,
pli-tv-kd3:1.2.5: ime pana samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā hemantam pi gimham pi vassam pi cārikaṃ caranti haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā bahū khuddake pāṇe saṃghātaṃ āpādentā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd3:1.3.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:1.3.2: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:1.3.3: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd3:2.1.2: kadā nu kho vassaṃ upagantabban ti.
pli-tv-kd3:2.1.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave vassāne vassaṃ upagantun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd3:2.2.6: aparajjugatāya āsāḷhiyā purimikā upagantabbā, māsagatāya āsāḷhiyā pacchimikā upagantabbā.
pli-tv-kd3:3.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vassaṃ upagantvā antarā vassaṃ cārikaṃ caranti.
pli-tv-kd3:3.1.3: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā hemantam pi gimham pi vassam pi cārikaṃ carissanti haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā bahū khuddake pāṇe saṃghātaṃ āpādentā.
pli-tv-kd3:3.1.4: ime hi nāma aññatitthiyā durakkhātadhammā vassāvāsaṃ alliyissanti saṃkāpayissanti,
pli-tv-kd3:3.1.5: ime hi nāma sakuntakā rukkhaggesu kulāvakāni karitvā vassāvāsaṃ alliyissanti saṃkāpayissanti,
pli-tv-kd3:3.1.6: ime pana samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā hemantam pi gimham pi vassam pi cārikaṃ caranti haritāni tiṇāni sammaddantā ekindriyaṃ jīvaṃ viheṭhentā bahū khuddake pāṇe saṃghātaṃ āpādentā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū vassaṃ upagantvā antarā vassaṃ cārikaṃ carissantīti.
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.4: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.5: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd3:3.2.6: na bhikkhave vassaṃ upagantvā purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ avasitvā cārikā pakkamitabbā.
pli-tv-kd3:4.1.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū na icchanti vassaṃ upagantuṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:4.2.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū tadahu vassupanāyikāya vassaṃ anupagantukāmā sañcicca āvāsaṃ atikkamanti.
pli-tv-kd3:4.2.3: na bhikkhave tadahu vassupanāyikāya vassaṃ anupagantukāmena sañcicca āvāso atikkamitabbo.
pli-tv-kd3:4.3.1: tena kho pana samayena rājā Māgadho Seniyo Bimbisāro vassaṃ ukkaḍḍhitukāmo bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pāhesi,
pli-tv-kd3:4.3.2: yadi pan' ayyā āgame juṇhe vassaṃ upagaccheyyun ti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.1: atha kho bhagavā Rājagahe yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthi tad avasari.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.4: tena kho pana samayena Kosalesu janapadesu Udenena upāsakena saṃghaṃ uddissa viharo kārāpito hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.1.6: āgacchantu bhaddantā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd3:5.2.3: na vassaṃ upagantvā purimaṃ vā temāsaṃ pacchimaṃ vā temāsaṃ avasitvā cārikā pakkamitabbā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.2.4: āgametu Udeno upāsako yāva bhikkhū vassaṃ vasanti,
pli-tv-kd3:5.2.6: sace pan' assa accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, tatth' eva āvāsikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ santike vihāraṃ patiṭṭhāpetū 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd3:5.3.2: kathaṃ hi nāma bhaddantā mayā pahite na āgacchissanti,
pli-tv-kd3:5.3.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū Udenassa upāsakassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-kd3:5.3.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. ||3||
pli-tv-kd3:5.4.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-kd3:5.4.2: anujānāmi bhikkhave sattannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite gantuṃ, na tv eva appahite,
pli-tv-kd3:5.4.3: bhikkhussa bhikkhuniyā sikkhamānāya sāmaṇerassa sāmaṇeriyā upāsakassa upāsikāya.
pli-tv-kd3:5.4.4: anujānāmi bhikkhave imesaṃ sattannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite gantuṃ, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:5.5.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsakena saṃghaṃ uddissa vihāro kārāpito hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.5.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.5.3: āgacchantu bhaddantā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:5.6.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsakena saṃghaṃ uddissa aḍḍhayogo kārāpito hoti,
pli-tv-kd3:5.6.21: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.6.22: āgacchantu bhaddantā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:5.7.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsakena sambahule bhikkhū uddissa --la--
pli-tv-kd3:5.7.2: ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ uddissa vihāro kārāpito h.,
pli-tv-kd3:5.8.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsakena bhikkhunīsaṃghaṃ uddissa --la--
pli-tv-kd3:5.8.9: ekaṃ sāmaṇeriṃ uddissa vihāro kārāpito hoti,
pli-tv-kd3:5.8.27: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.8.28: āgacchantu bhaddantā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:5.9.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsakena attano atthāya nivesanaṃ kārāpitaṃ hoti --la--
pli-tv-kd3:5.9.15: rasavatī k. h., vaccakuṭī k. h.,
pli-tv-kd3:5.9.19: udapānasālā k. h., jantāgharaṃ k. h., jantāgharasālā k. h.,
pli-tv-kd3:5.9.28: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.9.29: āgacchantu bhaddantā imaṃ suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇissanti pur' āyaṃ suttanto palujjatīti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.9.30: aññataraṃ vā pan' assa kiccaṃ hoti karaṇīyaṃ vā. so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.9.31: āgacchantu bhaddantā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:5.10.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsikāya saṃghaṃ uddisa vihāro kārāpito hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.10.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.10.3: āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:5.11.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsikāya saṃghaṃ uddissa aḍḍhayogo kārāpito . . . (= 6) . . . ārāmavatthuṃ
pli-tv-kd3:5.12.1: idha pana bhikkhave upāsikāya sambahule bhikkhū uddissa -- la
pli-tv-kd3:5.12.39: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.12.40: āgacchantu ayyā imaṃ suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇissanti pur' āyaṃ suttanto palujjatīti.
pli-tv-kd3:5.12.41: aññataraṃ vā pan' assā kiccaṃ hoti karaṇīyaṃ vā. sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.12.42: āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:5.13.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunā saṃghaṃ uddissa,
pli-tv-kd3:5.13.17: attano atthāya vihāro kārāpito hoti . . . (= 8) . . . ārāmāvatthuṃ
pli-tv-kd3:5.13.35: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:5.13.36: āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi dānañ ca dātuṃ dhammañ ca sotuṃ bhikkhū ca passitun ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:6.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.1.3: ahaṃ hi gilāno, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.1.5: anujānāmi bhikkhave pañcannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi gantuṃ, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.1.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave imesaṃ pañcannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi gantuṃ, pag eva pahite.
pli-tv-kd3:6.2.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.2.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.2.3: ahaṃ hi gilāno, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.2.4: gilānabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānupaṭṭhākabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānabhesajjaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, pucchissāmi vā, upaṭṭhahissāmi vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa anabhirati uppannā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.3.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.3.3: anabhirati me uppannā, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.3.4: anabhiratiṃ vūpakāsessāmi vā vūpakāsāpessāmi vā dhammakathaṃ vāssa karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa kukkuccaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.4.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.4.3: kukkuccaṃ me uppannaṃ, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.4.4: kukkuccaṃ vinodessāmi vā vinodāpessāmi vā dhammakathaṃ vāssa karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.5.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.5.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.5.3: diṭṭhigataṃ me uppannaṃ, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.5.4: diṭṭhigataṃ vivecessāmi vā vivecāpessāmi vā dhammakathaṃ vāssa karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.6.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu garudhammaṃ ajjhāpanno hoti parivāsāraho.
pli-tv-kd3:6.6.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.6.3: ahaṃ hi garudhammaṃ ajjhāpanno parivāsāraho, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.6.4: parivāsadānaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.7.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu mūlāya paṭikassanāraho hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.7.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.7.3: ahaṃ hi mūlāya paṭikassanāraho, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.7.4: mūlāya paṭikassanaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.8.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu mānattāraho hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.8.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.8.3: ahaṃ hi mānattāraho, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.8.4: mānattadānaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.9.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhu abbhānāraho hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.9.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.9.3: ahaṃ hi abbhānāraho, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.9.4: abbhānaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.10.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa saṃgho kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd3:6.10.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.10.3: saṃgho me kammaṃ kattukāmo, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.10.4: kin ti nu kho saṃgho kammaṃ na kareyya lahukāya vā pariṇāmeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.11.1: kataṃ vā pan' assa hoti saṃghena kammaṃ tajjaniyaṃ vā . . . ukkhepaniyaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd3:6.11.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.11.3: saṃgho me kammaṃ akāsi, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.11.4: kin ti nu kho sammāvatteyya lomaṃ pāteyya netthāraṃ vatteyya, saṃgho taṃ kammaṃ paṭippassambheyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.12.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.12.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.12.3: ahaṃ hi gilānā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.12.4: gilānabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānupaṭṭhākabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānabhesajjaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, pucchissāmi vā, upaṭṭhahissāmi vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.13.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā anabhirati uppannā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.13.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.13.3: anabhirati me uppannā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.13.4: anabhiratiṃ vūpakāsessāmi vā vūpakāsāpessāmi vā dhammakathaṃ vāssā karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.14.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā kukkuccaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.14.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.14.3: kukkuccaṃ me uppannaṃ, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.14.4: kukkuccaṃ vinodessāmi vā vinodāpessāmi vā dhammakathaṃ vāssā karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.15.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.15.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.15.3: diṭṭhigataṃ me uppannaṃ, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.15.4: diṭṭhigataṃ vivecessāmi vā vivecāpessāmi vā dhammakathaṃ vāssā karissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.16.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunī garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannā hoti mānattārahā.
pli-tv-kd3:6.16.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.16.3: ahaṃ hi garudhammaṃ ajjhāpannā mānattārahā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.17.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunī mūlāya paṭikassanārahā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.17.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.17.3: ahaṃ hi mūlāya paṭikassanārahā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.18.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunī abbhānārahā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.18.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.18.3: ahaṃ hi abbhānārahā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyā saṃgho kammaṃ kattukāmo hoti
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.2: tajjaniyaṃ vā nissayaṃ vā pabbājaniyaṃ vā paṭisāraṇiyaṃ vā ukkhepaniyaṃ vā.
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.3: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.4: saṃgho me kammaṃ kattukāmo, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.19.5: kin ti nu kho saṃgho kammaṃ na kareyya lahukāya vā pariṇāmeyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.1: kataṃ vā pan' assā hoti saṃghena kammaṃ
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.3: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.4: saṃgho me kammaṃ akāsi, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.20.5: kin ti nu kho sammāvatteyya lomaṃ pāteyya netthāraṃ vatteyya, saṃgho taṃ kammaṃ paṭippassambheyyā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.21.1: idha pana bhikkhave sikkhamānā gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.21.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.21.3: ahaṃ hi gilānā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena apahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.21.4: gilānabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi gilānupaṭṭhākabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānabhesajjaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, pucchissāmi vā, upaṭṭhahissāmi vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.22.1: idha pana bhikkhave sikkhamānāya anabhirati uppannā hoti --la--
pli-tv-kd3:6.22.5: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.22.6: sikkhā me kupitā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.23.1: idha pana bhikkhave sikkhamānā upasampajjitukāmā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.23.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.23.3: ahaṃ hi upasampajjitukāmā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.23.4: upasampadaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.24.1: idha pana bhikkhave sāmaṇero gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.24.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.24.3: ahaṃ hi gilāno, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.24.4: gilānabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānupaṭṭhākabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānabhesajjaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, pucchissāmi vā, upaṭṭhahissāmi vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.25.1: idha pana bhikkhave sāmaṇerassa anabhirati uppannā hoti --la--
pli-tv-kd3:6.25.5: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.25.6: ahaṃ hi vassaṃ pucchitukāmo, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.26.1: idha pana bhikkhave sāmaṇero upasampajjitukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.26.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.26.3: ahaṃ hi upasampajjitukāmo, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.26.4: upasampadaṃ ussukkaṃ karissāmi vā, anussāvessāmi vā, gaṇapūrako vā bhavissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.27.1: idha pana bhikkhave sāmaṇerī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.27.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.27.3: ahaṃ hi gilānā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.27.4: gilānabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānupaṭṭhākabhattaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, gilānabhesajjaṃ vā pariyesissāmi, pucchissāmi vā, upaṭṭhahissāmi vā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.28.1: idha pana bhikkhave sāmaṇeriyā anabhirati uppannā hoti --la--
pli-tv-kd3:6.28.5: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.28.6: ahaṃ hi vassaṃ pucchitukāmā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:6.29.1: idha pana bhikkhave sāmaṇerī sikkhaṃ samādiyitukāmā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:6.29.2: sā ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:6.29.3: ahaṃ hi sikkhaṃ samādiyitukāmā, āgacchantu ayyā, icchāmi ayyānaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:7.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno mātā gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.1.3: ahaṃ hi gilānā, āgacchatu me putto, icchāmi puttassa āgatan ti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.1.4: atha kho tassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-kd3:7.1.6: sattannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite gantuṃ, na tv eva appahite,
pli-tv-kd3:7.1.7: pañcannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi gantuṃ, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:7.1.8: ayañ ca me mātā gilānā sā ca anupāsikā. kathaṃ nu kho mayā paṭipajjitabban ti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.2.1: anujānāmi bhikkhave sattannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi gantuṃ, pag eva pahite,
pli-tv-kd3:7.2.2: bhikkhussa bhikkhuniyā sikkhamānāya sāmaṇerassa sāmaṇeriyā mātuyā ca pitussa ca.
pli-tv-kd3:7.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave imesaṃ sattannaṃ sattāhakaraṇīyena appahite pi gantuṃ, pag eva pahite.
pli-tv-kd3:7.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa mātā gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.3.2: sā ce puttassa santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:7.3.3: ahaṃ hi gilānā, āgacchatu me putto, icchāmi puttassa āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ . . . (= III.6.2) . . .
pli-tv-kd3:7.4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa pitā gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.4.2: so ce puttassa santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:7.4.3: ahaṃ hi gilāno, āgacchatu me putto, icchāmi puttassa āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ . . . (= III.6.2) . . .
pli-tv-kd3:7.5.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa bhātā gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.5.2: so ce bhātuno santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:7.5.3: ahaṃ hi gilāno, āgacchatu me bhātā, icchāmi bhātuno āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:7.6.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa bhaginī gilānā hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.6.2: sā ce bhātuno santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:7.7.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhussa ñātako gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.7.2: so ce bhikkhussa santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:7.7.3: ahaṃ hi gilāno, āgacchatu bhaddanto, icchāmi bhaddantassa āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:7.8.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhugatiko gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:7.8.2: so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtam pahiṇeyya,
pli-tv-kd3:7.8.3: ahaṃ hi gilāno, āgacchantu bhikkhū, icchāmi bhikkhūnaṃ āgatan ti, gantabbaṃ bhikkhave sattāhakaraṇīyena pahite, na tv eva appahite.
pli-tv-kd3:8.1.1: tena kho pana samayena saṃghassa vihāro udriyati.
pli-tv-kd3:8.1.2: aññatarena upāsakena araññe bhaṇḍaṃ chedāpitaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:8.1.4: sace bhaddantā taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avahareyyuṃ, dajjāhaṃ taṃ bhaṇḍan ti.
pli-tv-kd3:9.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Kosalesu janapadesu aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassupagatā bhikkhū vāḷehi ubbāḷhā honti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.1.4: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū vāḷehi ubbāḷhā honti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.1.8: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū siriṃsapehi ubbāḷhā honti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.2.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū corehi ubbālha honti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.2.5: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū pisācehi ubbāḷhā honti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gāmo agginā daḍḍho hoti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.3.5: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ agginā daḍḍhaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.4.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gāmo udakena vuḷho hoti,
pli-tv-kd3:9.4.5: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanaṃ udakena vuḷhaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-kd3:10.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassupagatānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gāmo corehi vuṭṭhāsi.
pli-tv-kd3:10.1.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave yena gāmo tena gantun ti.
pli-tv-kd3:10.1.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave yena bahutarā tena gantun ti.
pli-tv-kd3:10.1.9: anujānāmi bhikkhave yena saddhā pasannā tena gantun ti. ||1||10||
pli-tv-kd3:11.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Kosalesu janapadesu aññatarasmiṃ āvāse vassupagatā bhikkhū na labhiṃsu lūkhassa vā pāṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:11.1.3: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū na labhanti lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:11.1.6: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū labhanti lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, na labhanti sappāyāni bhojanāni.
pli-tv-kd3:11.2.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū labhanti lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, labhanti sappāyāni bhojanāni, na labhanti sappāyāni bhesajjāni.
pli-tv-kd3:11.2.4: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagatā bhikkhū labhanti lūkhassa vā paṇītassa vā bhojanassa yāvadatthaṃ pāripūriṃ, labhanti sappāyāni bhojanāni, labhanti sappāyāni bhesajjāni, na labhanti paṭirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:11.3.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagataṃ bhikkhuṃ itthi nimanteti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.3.2: ehi bhante hiraññaṃ vā te demi, suvaṇṇaṃ vā te demi, khettaṃ vā t. d., vatthuṃ vā t. d., gāvuṃ vā t. d., gāviṃ vā t. d., dāsaṃ vā t. d., dāsiṃ vā t. d., dhītaraṃ vā t. d. bhariyatthāya, ahaṃ vā te bhariyā homi, aññaṃ vā te bhariyaṃ ānemīti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.3.4: lahuparivattaṃ kho cittaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, siyāpi me brahmacariyassa antarāyo 'ti, pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:11.4.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagataṃ bhikkhuṃ vesī nimanteti --la--
pli-tv-kd3:11.4.8: ehi bhante hiraññaṃ vā te dema . . . dhītaraṃ vā te dema bhariyatthāya, aññaṃ vā te bhariyaṃ ānessāmā 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.4.12: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu asāmikaṃ nidhiṃ passati.
pli-tv-kd3:11.5.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu passati sambahule bhikkhū saṃghabhedāya parakkamante.
pli-tv-kd3:11.5.4: mā mayi sammukhībhūte saṃgho bhijjīti, pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:11.5.6: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.6.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.6.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulā bhikkhū saṃghabhedāya parakkamantīti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.6.5: ty āhaṃ vakkhāmi: garuko kho āvuso saṃghabhedo vutto bhagavatā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.6.7: karissanti me vacanaṃ sussūsissanti sotaṃ odahissantīti, pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:11.7.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu saṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.7.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulā bhikkhū saṃghabhedāya parakkamantīti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.7.4: te kho me bhikkhū na mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.7.5: api ca ye tesaṃ mittā te me mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.8.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.8.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saṃgho bhinno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.9.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.9.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saṃgho bhinno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.9.4: te kho me bhikkhū na mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.9.5: api ca ye tesaṃ mittā te me mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.10.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.10.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulā bhikkhuniyo saṃghabhedāya parakkamantīti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.10.5: tāhaṃ vakkhāmi: garuko kho bhaginiyo saṃghabhedo vutto bhagavatā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.10.7: karissanti me vacanaṃ sussūsissanti sotaṃ odahissantīti, pakkamitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:11.11.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.11.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulā bhikkhuniyo saṃghabhedāya parakkamantīti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.11.4: tā kho me bhikkhuniyo na mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.11.5: api ca yā tāsaṃ mittā tā me mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.12.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.12.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulāhi bhikkhunīhi saṃgho bhinno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.13.1: idha pana bhikkhave vassupagato bhikkhu suṇāti:
pli-tv-kd3:11.13.2: amukasmiṃ kira āvāse sambahulāhi bhikkhunīhi saṃgho bhinno 'ti.
pli-tv-kd3:11.13.4: tā kho me bhikkhuniyo na mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.13.5: api ca yā tāsaṃ mittā tā me mittā,
pli-tv-kd3:11.13.7: tā vuttā tā vakkhanti: garuko . . . (= 10) . . . vassacchedassa. ||13||11||
pli-tv-kd3:12.1.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu vaje vassaṃ upagantukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.1.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave vaje vassaṃ upagantun ti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.1.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave yena vajo tena gantum ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd3:12.2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu upakaṭṭhāya vassupanāyikāya satthena gantukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave satthe vassaṃ upagantun ti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.2.4: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu upakaṭṭhāya vassupanāyikāya nāvāya gantukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.2.6: anujānāmi bhikkhave nāvāya vassaṃ upagantun ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd3:12.3.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū rukkhasusire vassaṃ upagacchanti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.4.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū rukkhaviṭabhiyā vassaṃ upagacchanti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.5.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū ajjhokāse vassaṃ upagacchanti,
pli-tv-kd3:12.5.2: deve vassante rukkhamūlam pi nimbakosam pi upadhāvanti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.6.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū asenāsanakā vassaṃ upagacchanti,
pli-tv-kd3:12.6.2: sītena pi kilamanti uṇhena pi kilamanti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.7.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chavakuṭikāya vassaṃ upagacchanti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.8.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chatte vassaṃ upagacchanti.
pli-tv-kd3:12.9.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū cāṭiyā vassaṃ upagacchanti.
pli-tv-kd3:13.1.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyā saṃghena katikā katā hoti
pli-tv-kd3:13.1.3: Visākhāya Migāramātuyā nattā bhikkhū upasaṃkamitvā pabbajjaṃ yāci.
pli-tv-kd3:13.1.5: saṃghena kho āvuso kātikā katā antarā vassaṃ na pabbājetabban ti,
pli-tv-kd3:13.1.6: āgamehi āvuso yāva bhikkhū vassaṃ vasanti,
pli-tv-kd3:13.1.8: atha kho te bhikkhū vassaṃ vutthā Visākhāya Migāramātuyā nattāraṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-kd3:13.1.11: sac' āhaṃ bhante pabbajito assaṃ, abhirameyyām' āhaṃ,
pli-tv-kd3:13.2.2: kathañ hi nāma ayyā evarūpaṃ katikaṃ karissanti
pli-tv-kd3:13.2.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū Visākhāya Migāramātuyā ujjhāyantiyā khīyantiyā vipācentiyā.
pli-tv-kd3:13.2.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:13.2.7: na bhikkhave evarūpā katikā kātabbā antarā vassaṃ
pli-tv-kd3:14.1.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā Upanandena Sakyaputtena rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa vassāvāso paṭissuto hoti purimikāya.
pli-tv-kd3:14.1.2: so taṃ āvāsaṃ gacchanto addasa antarā magge dve āvāse bahucīvarake,
pli-tv-kd3:14.1.4: nūnāhaṃ imesu dvīsu āvāsesu vassaṃ vaseyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd3:14.1.6: so tesu dvīsu āvāsesu vassaṃ vasi.
pli-tv-kd3:14.1.7: rājā Pasenadi Kosalo ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-kd3:14.1.8: kathañ hi nāma ayyo Upanando Sakyaputto amhākaṃ vassāvāsaṃ paṭisuṇitvā visaṃvādessati.
pli-tv-kd3:14.1.9: nanu bhagavatā anekapariyāyena musāvādo garahito, musāvādā veramaṇī pasatthā 'ti. ||1||
pli-tv-kd3:14.2.1: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-kd3:14.2.2: ye te bhikkhū appicchā, te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-kd3:14.2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa vassāvāsaṃ paṭisuṇitvā visaṃvādessati.
pli-tv-kd3:14.2.4: nanu bhagavatā anekapariyāyena musāvādo garahito, musāvādā veramaṇī pasatthā 'ti. ||2||
pli-tv-kd3:14.3.1: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd3:14.3.2: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātāpetvā āyasmantaṃ Upanandaṃ Sakyaputtaṃ paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-kd3:14.3.3: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa vassāvāsaṃ paṭisuṇitvā visaṃvādesīti.
pli-tv-kd3:14.3.6: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa vassāvāsaṃ paṭisuṇitvā visaṃvādessasi.
pli-tv-kd3:14.3.7: nanu mayā moghapurisa anekapariyāyena musāvādo garahito musāvādā veramaṇī pasatthā.
pli-tv-kd3:14.3.8: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --la--
pli-tv-kd3:14.4.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunā vassāvāso paṭissuto hoti purimikāyā.
pli-tv-kd3:14.4.2: so taṃ āvāsaṃ gacchanto passati antarā magge dve āvāse bahucīvarake,
pli-tv-kd3:14.4.4: yaṃ nūnāhaṃ imesu dvīsu āvāsesu vassaṃ vaseyyaṃ,
pli-tv-kd3:14.4.6: so tesu dvīsu āvāsesu vassaṃ vasati.
pli-tv-kd3:14.4.7: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||4||
pli-tv-kd3:14.5.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunā vassāvāso paṭissuto hoti purimikāya.
pli-tv-kd3:14.5.2: so taṃ āvāsaṃ gacchanto bahiddhā uposathaṃ karoti, pāṭipadena vihāraṃ upeti senāsanaṃ paññāpeti pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti pariveṇaṃ sammajjati,
pli-tv-kd3:14.5.4: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd3:14.5.8: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||5||
pli-tv-kd3:14.6.4: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd3:14.6.8: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd3:14.6.13: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-kd3:14.6.17: so taṃ sattāhaṃ anto sannivaṭṭaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-kd3:14.6.18: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca paññāyati paṭissave ca anāpatti. ||6||
pli-tv-kd3:14.7.3: so sattāhaṃ anāgatāya pavāraṇāya sakaraṇīyo pakkamati.
pli-tv-kd3:14.7.4: āgaccheyya vā so bhikkhave bhikkhu taṃ āvāsaṃ na vā āgaccheyya, tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca paññāyati paṭissave ca anāpatti. ||7||
pli-tv-kd3:14.8.1: idha pana bhikkhave bhikkhunā vassāvāso paṭissuto hoti purimikāya.
pli-tv-kd3:14.8.2: so taṃ āvāsaṃ gantvā uposathaṃ karoti, pāṭipadena vihāraṃ upeti senāsanaṃ paññāpeti pāniyaṃ paribhojaniyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti pariveṇaṃ sammajjati.
pli-tv-kd3:14.8.4: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||8||
pli-tv-kd3:14.9.5: so dvīhatīhaṃ vasitvā sakaraṇīyo pakkamati -- la
pli-tv-kd3:14.10.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa. ||9||
pli-tv-kd3:14.10.3: so taṃ sattāhaṃ anto sannivaṭṭaṃ karoti.
pli-tv-kd3:14.10.4: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno purimikā ca paññāyati paṭissave ca anāpatti.

pli-tv-kd3:14.11.4: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno pacchimikā ca na paññāyati paṭissave ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
